gap_map: IDENTITY/STAFF: user->coach is 1:1 via user_id FK; NO staff capability columns on baseball_team_coach_staff, NO baseball_staff_invitations table, NO staff invite/accept flow, NO staff auth hook, NO staff routes, NO capability-aware RLS helpers (has_baseball_staff_capability, can_view_baseball_player, etc.). Target: capability-driven staff model layered onto existing baseball_team_coach_staff + new baseball_staff_invitations, server-enforced.

IMPORT LINEAGE: baseball_stat_uploads TS Row (row_count/processed_count/file_url/status:string) MISMATCHES the archived SQL (total_rows/matched_rows/unmatched_rows/unmatched_data/stat_type/session_date) AND lacks import_run_id/source_id/mapping_config/match_confidence. NO baseball_import_runs, NO baseball_player_external_ids. Target: reconcile baseball_stat_uploads to a single canonical shape + add import_runs + external_ids for audited, rollback-able imports with stored match confidence.
TIMELINE/ACK: NO baseball_player_timeline_events (chronological player story), NO baseball_event_acknowledgements. Target: both added, feeding Command Center, Player Today, Profile/Timeline.
PRACTICE: NO baseball_practices / baseball_practice_blocks / baseball_practice_attendance. Target: practice header + timed blocks + attendance, optionally linked to baseball_events.

PERFORMANCE/LIFTING: NO lifting tables at all (sessions/exercises/assignments/results), NO wellness/readiness tables. Target: Performance Lite (exercise library + assignment + player-logged set results + readiness check-in) gated by strength_coach capabilities.

COACHHELM ENGINE: GolfHelm v3 engine (BaseGenerator, Diagnosis, confidence, lifecycle, window-honesty) exists and is sport-agnostic in spirit but golf-coupled in imports; baseball/actions/insights.ts is a manual stub. NO baseball_metrics registry, NO baseball event loaders, NO source-ref/confidence attribution columns. Target: extract shared engine layer to @/lib/coachhelm/shared + baseball generators reading box scores/stats with stored source refs.

READ MODELS: BaseballPlayerAggregates TS type claims fields (season_avg, career_obp/slg/ops, avg_pitch_velocity, development_stage, trend_velocity) that do NOT exist in DB; recalculatePlayerAggregates writes only ~14 of 22 claimed fields. Target: reconcile aggregate type<->schema and add the missing computed columns or trim the type.

TYPE SYNC: baseball_coach_recruiting_philosophy + player_percentiles exist in SQL but have NO TypeScript Row/Insert/Update types; baseball_stat_uploads.status is string not enum. Target: regenerate types after every migration; add enums.

NAV/ROUTES: recruiting routes exist but are client-guard-only (useRecruitingRouteProtection) bypassable by direct URL; mobile COACH_NAV/PLAYER_NAV hardcoded and out of sync with sidebar (missing stats/dev-plans/documents/travel); showcase coach falls back to college nav when coach_type undefined. Target: server-side capability gating + nav registry single source of truth.

SURFACES MISSING: NO Player Today/daily view, NO Stats Center hub, NO Practice Planner, NO Performance dashboard, NO Staff Decision Room, NO Player Profile Timeline, NO Import Center UI beyond StatsUploadClient, NO baseball CoachHelm UI. Command Center + Player Profile + team-mgmt surfaces exist and are reusable.

ERROR TRACKING: Sentry IS wired (instrumentation.ts/instrumentation-client.ts + server-error-logger.ts writing to error_logs + Sentry with scopes/tags/fingerprints) and 55 baseball error.tsx boundaries exist, but there is NO baseball-specific server-action wrapper with breadcrumbs/capability context, NO route-group-level error boundary for the new (dashboard) feature folders, and NO pipe from error_logs into the Command Center risk feed. Target: baseball action wrapper + risk-feed bridge reusing existing infra.
DEMO: NO baseball demo seed for the new Phase-1 surfaces (practice, lifting, timeline, imports, insights). Target: seeded demo team populated across all new tables.

migrations.name: 20260623T0001_baseball_stat_uploads_reconcile
migrations.purpose: Reconcile the baseball_stat_uploads TS-vs-SQL mismatch and add import lineage. Keep existing columns (row_count, processed_count, file_url, status, error_message, completed_at) and ADD the audit/lineage columns the code never persisted. Convert status to a strict enum via a CHECK rather than a destructive type swap.
migrations.sql_sketch:
ALTER TABLE public.baseball_stat_uploads
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS import_run_id uuid REFERENCES public.baseball_import_runs(id),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_id text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS import_type text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stat_type text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_date date,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_name text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mapping_config jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS match_confidence numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS matched_rows integer,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS unmatched_rows integer,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS unmatched_data jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();
-- backfill total/row alignment then add a non-destructive status guard
ALTER TABLE public.baseball_stat_uploads
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS baseball_stat_uploads_status_chk,
  ADD CONSTRAINT baseball_stat_uploads_status_chk
    CHECK (status IN ('pending','processing','validated','committed','failed','rolled_back','needs_review'));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bsu_import_run ON public.baseball_stat_uploads(import_run_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bsu_team ON public.baseball_stat_uploads(team_id);

rls.policy: Staff/admin only. SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE require is_baseball_team_staff(team_id) AND has_baseball_staff_capability(team_id,'can_manage_imports'); no player access (import rows are staff/admin only per rls_policy_plan_v2).
Team-scoped staff/admin only. All ops gated by is_baseball_team_staff(team_id) AND has_baseball_staff_capability(team_id,'can_manage_imports'). service_role bypass for cron only.
Team-scoped staff read/write with can_manage_imports; players may read only their own row (player_id = get_my_baseball_player_id()). UNIQUE(team_id,source,external_id) prevents dup mapping.

Read: any active team staff via is_baseball_team_staff(team_id). Write (role/capability/scope): only is_baseball_primary_coach(team_id) OR has_baseball_staff_capability(team_id,'can_invite_staff'). Never authorize from raw_user_meta_data.

INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE require is_baseball_primary_coach(team_id) OR can_invite_staff capability. SELECT by inviter or by invitee (email match / accepted_by_user_id = auth.uid()). Revoked/expired rows cannot be accepted (enforced in action + is_active/expires_at check).

Team staff read non-restricted via is_baseball_team_staff(team_id) AND can_view_baseball_player(team_id,player_id). Players read ONLY where visibility='player_visible' AND player_id = get_my_baseball_player_id(). 'restricted'/'staff_only' never appear in player queries. Writes: staff with relevant capability; system/AI writes via service_role.
User can SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE own rows (user_id = auth.uid()). Team staff can SELECT all team rows via is_baseball_team_staff(team_id). UNIQUE(event_id,user_id).
Staff read/write via is_baseball_team_staff(team_id); write gated by has_baseball_staff_capability(team_id,'can_manage_practice'). Players read only when status='published' (player-visible schedule).
Inherits practice visibility: staff read/write with can_manage_practice; players read blocks of published practices only.
Staff read/write via is_baseball_team_staff(team_id) + can_manage_practice. Player may read own attendance row (player_id = get_my_baseball_player_id()).
is_global rows readable by any team staff; team rows scoped to is_baseball_team_staff(team_id). Write gated by has_baseball_staff_capability(team_id,'can_manage_lifting').
Staff with can_manage_lifting create/edit for scoped groups/players (can_manage_baseball_lift_group). Player reads own assignments (player_id = get_my_baseball_player_id()).
Player INSERTs own results (player_id = get_my_baseball_player_id()). Strength coach + head coach read scoped results; other players cannot read others' loads (staff-restricted).
Player INSERTs/reads own check-ins. Staff read only with can_view_readiness; never framed as medical diagnosis; other players cannot read.

Inherits strictest source visibility among source_refs. Staff read team insights via is_baseball_team_staff(team_id); players read only insights explicitly marked player_visible. AI writes via service_role.
Existing team-scoped policy retained; new import_run_id/match_confidence inherit it (no widening).

error_tracking: REUSE existing infra, do not rebuild: Sentry is already wired via src/instrumentation.ts + src/instrumentation-client.ts (client Replay 100% on error / 10% session prod / 0% dev, maskAllText on), and src/lib/server-error-logger.ts already captures to BOTH Sentry and an error_logs table with severity, source, fingerprint, tags, route/url/featureArea, userId/userEmail, and a suppressCapture flag.

Sentry scopes/tags (baseball): create src/lib/baseball/with-baseball-action.ts that wraps every new baseball server action and sets scope tags: sport='baseball', feature_area (command_center|player_today|import|practice|lifting|coachhelm|staff), active_team_id, active_staff_role, capability_checked. Adds breadcrumbs for each step (auth_resolved, capability_checked, validated_input, db_write, revalidated). On throw, calls logServerTrace (server-error-logger) with action name + tags + fingerprint=[feature_area, action, errorCode], then returns formatSafeErrorResponse — never leaks raw DB errors to the client.

Server-action wrapper contract: withBaseballAction(name, {featureArea, requiredCapability}, fn) -> resolves user, resolves active_baseball_context, enforces requiredCapability server-side (capabilities.ts), pushes breadcrumbs, runs fn, catches, logs to error_logs + Sentry, returns {success,error?,data?}. This is the single choke point so every Phase-1 action gets identical breadcrumbs + capability context.

Route-group error boundaries: 55 baseball error.tsx already exist; ADD error.tsx at the new feature folders created in Phase 1 (staff, import, stats-center, practice, performance, player/today) so a server-component throw renders a branded recoverable boundary, and each error.tsx calls Sentry.captureException with tags {feature_area, route} in a useEffect. Add a single (dashboard)/dashboard/error.tsx group-level fallback if not already covering the new routes.

Client boundary: reuse the existing client Sentry init; wrap the new heavy client surfaces (CommandCenterClient, ImportWizardClient, PerformanceDashboardClient) in a shared <BaseballErrorBoundary> client component that captures render errors with component-name + feature_area tags and shows the cream/green EmptyState error variant (no white crash screen).

Risk-feed bridge (the new piece): create src/lib/baseball/risk-feed-bridge.ts that, on every error_logs insert for sport='baseball', also emits a Command Center risk event (via scripts/baseballhelm-build-event.mjs contract: --type risk for build-time, and a runtime equivalent writing to the command-center telemetry/events store). Severity maps: critical/error -> Control Tower ping + Critical Risk Strip; warning -> Risk card. This satisfies v12 'risk events ping the Control Tower' and surfaces real runtime errors in the operations UI rather than only Sentry.

Honesty rules from v12: distinguish 'logged intent' vs 'active capture'; show skipped/not-run states; never hide failures. The bridge tags each risk with its source (sentry|error_logs|build_event) so the Control Tower shows provenance.

Migration safety telemetry: every Wave-1/9 migration emits a build-event (--type migration) and on RLS-test failure emits --type test failure into the repair bay, so schema risk is visible in Supabase Tower + Test & Proof Lab.

risks: PROD vs branch migrations: applying additive ALTERs to baseball_stat_uploads + new tables directly to PROD is the established repo pattern (additive IF NOT EXISTS, idempotent) but the stat_uploads reconcile touches a table the live stats.ts writes to — a Supabase branch is safer for the reconcile + RLS rewrite, with merge after RLS tests pass. See open_questions.

Capability RLS is the highest-risk surface: a wrong helper (e.g., players reading staff_only timeline or other players' lift loads) is a data-leak. Every new table needs a pgTAP role-impersonation test BEFORE any UI reads it (Wave 1 ships tests alongside policies).

SECURITY DEFINER + service_role: the existing pattern grants EXECUTE to service_role only with search_path pinned; new helpers (has_baseball_staff_capability etc.) must follow it exactly or the cron/AI write path bypasses RLS. Agents have repeatedly shipped GRANT ALL TO anon on RPCs — explicitly REVOKE anon and verify pg_class.relacl after any matview/table recreate.

Type drift: every migration must be followed by db:types regen + the docs:check guard; baseball_coach_recruiting_philosophy/player_percentiles already drifted (SQL exists, no TS). Reconciling BaseballPlayerAggregates type to the real schema may break components that read phantom fields (season_avg, career_obp/slg/ops) — audit call sites before trimming.

CoachHelm engine extraction: moving BaseGenerator/Diagnosis to @/lib/coachhelm/shared risks breaking 6+ live golf generators. Do it as a pure re-home with re-exports + run golf coachhelm tests (Stryker/unit) green before adding baseball generators. Metric DIRECTION mistakes learn backward (velo drop as improvement) — replicate the registry exactly.

Box-score-only data quality: baseball has no pitch-level events, so generators must use box-score heuristics (K/BB as command proxy) and honestly disclose lower confidence; small rosters (12-25) may never reach the golf 0.5 confidence floor for thin bands — recalibrate thresholds rather than emit false 'high' priority.

Import rollback correctness: rollback must reverse only records created by a run and require before/after snapshots for updates; the no-destructive-writes rule (upsert/stage-and-swap, never delete-then-reinsert) applies to commit/rollback paths.
Calendar coupling: BaseballCalendarWrapper depends on golf PremiumCalendarClient with no type adapter; practice/ack event injection could break it on a golf refactor.
